The `meta` parameter is accepted as a Dict[str, Any] from callers like `Style.from_meta()` and can contain arbitrary Python objects. When `pickle.loads()` deserializes a malicious pickle payload, it will execute arbitrary code during deserialization.

This meta dict is serialized using pickle.dumps() and stored in _meta field. When the meta property is accessed (line 471), it deserializes using pickle.loads(), which can execute arbitrary code.

This is a vendor directory (pip/_vendor/rich/), but the vulnerability is still exploitable if an attacker can influence the meta parameter passed to Style objects.
